product_family: Dimensions is a comprehensive research database platform with over 112M publications, 41M+ patents, and 5.6M+ grants. Sub-products: Dimensions Analytics, Landscape & Discovery, Perspectives & Insights, Reviewer Finder, Research Security, GBQ (BigQuery integration), API, Industry Partnerships, and Dimensions Badges.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: group operations (Human Resources, Group IT, Finance, Marketing and Legal) and product divisions: Dimensions, ReadCube Papers, Overleaf, Symplectic, Figshare, Altmetric and Metaphacts

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27701:2019 (Privacy Information Management)
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy Information Management System... the product division of Dimensions, including customer management and support. Certificate Number 21331/1. Valid until January 3, 2029.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type I
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on Digital Science security certifications page or Dimensions website

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on Digital Science security certifications page or Dimensions website

certifications.name: HIPAA / BAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance on Dimensions.ai, Digital Science, or related documentation

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: The privacy policy explicitly addresses European data privacy laws and provides multiple legal bases for processing. Includes EU-US Data Privacy Framework section with dispute resolution procedures.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found in searches of Digital Science or Dimensions domains

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. Dimensions offers AI features (Research GPT, AI Summarization) but no AI governance certification mentioned.

privacy.ai_training_note: Dimensions integrated machine learning starting in 2015 for classification and clustering. Introduced Research GPT (partnership with OpenAI) in 2023. Privacy policy does not mention using customer data for AI model training. Customers can integrate their own data with Dimensions for analysis, but no explicit statement on whether such customer data is used for model improvement.
privacy.data_region: Hosted on Google Cloud's BigQuery (multi-region, not Dimensions-specific)

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: Google Cloud BigQuery (serverless, highly scalable data warehouse)

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Implicit via Google Cloud BigQuery; no explicit vendor-level claim documented

security.name: GDPR Compliance
security.value: EU-US Data Privacy Framework compliance; multiple legal bases for processing (consent, contract, legal obligation, legitimate interest)

flags: Google BigQuery infrastructure: SOC 2 Type II cert belongs to Google Cloud, not Dimensions. Dimensions does not claim SOC 2.
ISO 27001/27701 certs issued to Digital Science group covering 'group operations and product divisions' - Dimensions SaaS is included in scope per certificate documentation.
No public Data Processing Agreement (DPA) available on website - customers likely must request via sales channel.
AI features (Research GPT, AI Summarization) introduced in 2023 - no explicit data governance policy or training-data disclaimer visible on AI product page.
Research Security product is aligned with government compliance (NSPM-33, watchlists) but vendor does not claim HIPAA, FedRAMP, or PCI DSS.
No SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 42001, or other compliance certs beyond ISO 27001/27701 and GDPR.
Accessibility (VPAT) compliance documented for enterprise/government use.
